hints.title: Split Words by Space
hints.text: Split the sentence into words separated by spaces.

hints.title: Prefix Matching
hints.text: Check each word using startswith(searchWord). Indices are 1-indexed.

hints.title: Return First Match
hints.text: Return the 1-based index of the first matching word, or -1 if no word matches.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive pitfalls; direct prefix check per word is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scanning words sequentially gives first prefix match in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks prefix property on tokens and respects 1-based indexing.
complexity.notes: Words are separated by single spaces.
